display_name: 源域多层识别特征与波形梯度诊断
description: 复用28条合法源配对和固定源恢复器，比较F0浅层、中层、最终特征及波形损失对恢复IQ的梯度；无训练或目标访问。
authorization: 用户授权原L_s/U_s源模拟配对及同一冻结F0连续特征指导；不使用TX标签、logits、V/OE或目标，不更新模型。

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI, GPU4 or GPU6, CPU threads2, FP64 posterior FP32 models, TF32 off

data.version: Original392005 source contract; R07 63000 source physical pairs draw01
data.representation: Fixed original L_s/U_s paired clean and simulated received IQ, 28 records; source F0 feature maps
data.contract_ref: OriginalTriSIGSSL F0 source_contract andsource_pair metadata;R07 original63000source physicalset/roles matchbyID
data.physical_ids_ref: First 2 original order records each of 7 scenes × L_s/U_s; fixed nonrepresentative sample
data.label_map_ref: No TX label or logits read
data.validation_ref: VALIDATED_ONCE original source handles, fixed original F0 and legal source E30 provenance
data.actual_training_labels: No training and no identity labels

permissions.query_use: No target, identity labels, classifier logits or model updates
permissions.claim_scope: Exploratory restored-IQ gradient cosines for 28 nonrepresentative source records; not G parameter gradients or performance.

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen original source-only CovarianceDetail final30/7410 and original Tri-SIG-TIME SSL F0; no optimizer
sources: Original Tri-SIG-TIME SSL F0 frozen source feature model
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Original source roles and VALIDATED_ONCE, checkpoint source-only metadata checked in program
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Same original L_s/U_s source contract; source-only final30 and F0 metadata validated; no model updates or target access
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed final30; first two source records for each role and each of seven source scenes, no TX-based selection.

execution.gpu_policy: GPU4 or 6, one own process, at least 12000 MiB free, total GPU compute cap 3 including other owners
execution.stop_rule: Source/F0/checkpoint mismatch, invalid layer calls, nonfinite features or gradients, posterior residual >1e-8, smoke failure, GPU cap violation or unverifiable GPU count: stop only own child, preserve outputs.

metric_names: Pairwise cosine and norms of waveform, shallow, middle and final F0 feature losses with respect to restored IQ
Source-layer shapes and normalized feature errors, posterior solve residual
dimensions: single fixed source final30 recovery model
metrics_plan.prediction_ref: Frozen F0 continuous features only; no logits, TX or target

rows.purpose: Determine whether different fixed F0 feature levels provide distinct local input-gradient directions from waveform and final feature losses.
rows.seed_notes: Fixed source-only E30 model; original source draw and order; support N/A; evaluation seed identifies original draw.
rows.scenario: 28 original L_s/U_s records, two per role in each of seven source scenes
rows.budget_ref: 28 source records including first two real model smoke; no model updates

notes: No target, TX labels, classifier logits, V/OE or model updates.
Input-gradient direction is not G parameter-gradient direction or formal recognition performance.
Single seed and 28 nonrepresentative source records; no theoretical limit.
Smoke occurs on first two actual source records and continues on PASS.
